instruction: Initialize an LDAP directory with a base domain entry
output:
<think>
This is asking us to initialize an LDAP directory with a base domain entry.
The tool for this job is cat — cat operations.
After running, confirm it worked as expected before moving on.
</think>
cat > /tmp/base.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: dcObject
objectClass: organization
objectClass: top
dc: example
o: Example Inc.
EOF
ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,cn=config -w secret -f /tmp/base.ldif

instruction: Set up an LDAP replica with an updated referral
output:

We're being asked to set up an LDAP replica with an updated referral.
